blocks.text: Builds economy and support ships (warships come from a Shipyard), takes in cargo and defends itself, but makes no resources. Lose every starbase with no Constructor left to build another and you lose; losing your worlds alone does not. Keep it clear of nearly drained gas giants.
Builds warships (starbases don't): a hull with the variant and researched Mod you pick (see Shipyards below).
A forward drop-off: harvesters unload here instead of flying home, so a station beside a far belt or nebula shortens every trip. Unarmed: guard it.
Half a starbase that only holds ground: no building, no cargo. Construct weapon research applies to its guns.
Right-click it with ships selected to garrison them; they still cost upkeep and die with the gate.
Stats read cost, build time, shield / armor / hull, guns and upkeep.
Construct guns get flat extra reach, so every gun hits a corvette at max range from any angle.
The bonus ignores Mods and Munitions research.
